description: Auto-discovers a 2D cross-reference grid from page elements (RTM); composes <data-table> for sortable + heatmap-able presentation

attributes.name: rows
attributes.description: CSS selector for row source elements

attributes.name: cols
attributes.description: CSS selector for column source elements

attributes.name: link-attr
attributes.description: Attribute on the row element whose value(s) reference column identifiers (see match-attr); comma-separated values supported

attributes.name: match-attr
attributes.description: Attribute on column elements that link-attr values are matched against. Default: the column's id, story-id (<user-story>) or item-id (<work-item>), whichever matches

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Optional heading shown above the matrix

attributes.name: row-label
attributes.description: Header cell text for the row axis

attributes.name: flag-orphans
attributes.description: Mark empty rows/columns with data-orphan for CSS targeting

childAttributes.name: data-matrix-label
childAttributes.description: Override the label rendered for this element in matrices that include it

events.name: traceability-matrix:highlight
events.description: Fired when a cell toggles chain highlight (click, or Enter/Space on the cell's button)
